description: Prepare an optional website continuation link for an existing owner-bound review, saved design or quote request, preserving homeowner or Pro context. Use only when the user wants to continue in the app/site or wants a continuation link. It creates a temporary locator, not a login or approval grant. The original Yarda account must sign in to resume. Opening the link never approves an outline, starts a design, charges, shares contact details or starts checkout. Installed-app handling depends on supported device routes; do not promise it. It is not a substitute for the in-chat journey. To send a saved design for quotes where the in-chat quote card is unavailable, give the quote page link from get_quote_options instead.

target_id.description: An existing review, saved design or quote request belonging to this account.

target_revision.description: The current review revision; omit for design and quote targets.
